subject: PROPOSED cinematography R&D and A/B pilot package for review with Ziggy
body: CFA Nova: Ziggy requested review WITH HIM of this proposed cinematography (lighting and camera) R&D brief and reusable A/B pilot package. Both originals are copied unchanged and hash-verified. No candidate is assigned or ranked, no generation or paid run is launched, and no pipeline is adopted. Compare identical written packages before a proposed lead/team recommendation. Pass A preserves the source camera movement/action and isolates one motivated lighting change; Pass B is a distinct proposed camera treatment. The three supplied examples remain bounded research. Claude was separately notified through mailbox message68fd68f7-d08c-4e28-abe2-40bbc413d69d. Review with Ziggy before candidate assignment or a new render.
